instruction.text: Finde Kalifornien auf der Karte und tippe es an.

atoms.text: California, also called the Golden State, is a state on the west coast of the US. It is known for its warm climate, beautiful beaches and many national parks.

atoms.a: The Golden Gate Bridge is one of the most famous bridges in the world.
San Francisco Cable Cars are part of the railway systems of San Francisco.
Alcatraz Island is a small offshore island from San Francisco, which locates a former prison.
The Painted Ladies are colourfully painted Victorian houses in San Francisco.

atoms.b: California has many beautiful ((++national_parks beaches)), for example Yosemite National Park, Joshua Tree National Park and Pinnacles National Park.

instruction.text: Welche Nationalparks befinden sich in Kalifornien? Wähle aus.
Lies den Text und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>giant sequoia trees</voice> bedeutet Riesenmammutbaum

atoms.text: Yosemite National Park is one of the largest national parks in California. It covers an area of about 3,000 square kilometres and is located roughly 300 kilometres east of San Francisco. Many waterfalls can be found there, for instance Yosemite Falls, which is the tallest waterfall in North America. Yosemite National Park is also home to giant sequoia trees. Moreover, a lot of lakes, rivers and mountains can be found in Yosemite National Park.
